    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    DemoApplication
    This class orchestrates the bootstrapping of the Spring Boot framework and serves as the central configuration hub It integrates multiple data persistence layers and enables asynchronous task execution to handle computationally intensive Text Analytics processes without blocking the main execution thread
    DocumentController
    REST Controller that orchestrates the document processing pipeline This component exposes endpoints for the entire lifecycle of the data: from initial ingestion and topic modeling analysis (with Mallet) to synchronization with the search engine and final information retrieval
    DocumentIterator
    This class implements the "Iterator" interface to transform tab-separated values into Mallet "Instance" objects
    DocumentRaw
    Entity representing MongoDB "raw_documents" collection Class that stores the main dataset (metadata and results of topic modeling) maintaining a reference to the global topics defined in the "topics" collection
    DocumentSearch
    Class mapped to the Elasticsearch index "project_index" It defines specific field types to leverage full-text search for content and matching for metadata
    DocumentSearch.SearchableTopic
    Inner DTO representing a specific topic association
    ElasticConfig
    This class extends "ElasticsearchConfiguration" to provide specialized infrastructure setup for the Elasticsearch connection
    ElasticDocumentRepository
    Repository interface for Elasticsearch operations on "DocumentSearch" entities This component supports: - Full-Text Search: partial match on the document content - Field Search: partial match based on a field other than the content field according to the syntax “field:value”
    FetchService
    Service responsible for the initial data ingestion phase It handles the extraction of raw data from JSONL files, performs initial cleaning and domain extraction, and persists the resulting entities into MongoDB
    IndexService
    Service dedicated to data synchronization between MongoDB and Elasticsearch
    JsonlEnhancer
    This class ensures that the ingested documents follow a specific field ordering and filters out redundant metadata before the persistence phase
    MongoDocumentRepository
    Repository interface for MongoDB operations on "DocumentRaw" entities
    TextCleaner
    This class provides methods to normalize raw text by removing numerical values, redundant whitespaces and stopwords
    Topic
    Entity representing MongoDB "topics" collection Class that acts like a metadata repository (top words and weights) for the topics extracted from the document content
    TopicModelingService
    This service performs Topic Modeling (via Mallet) to identify themes within the document corpus; it uses an asynchronous approach to handle the high computational cost of the training phase
    TopicRepository
    Repository interface for MongoDB operations on "Topic" entities
